title: The Holy Spirit
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The learner describes Pentecost (Acts 2:1-13: wind, tongues of fire, other languages), analyses how Christians show the fruit of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23) and explains the importance of taking part in church activities (growth in faith, using gifts, responsibility, fellowship; Hebrews 10:24-25).

floor.prerequisite: Knows the gifts and fruit of the Holy Spirit.
floor.question: Is kindness a gift or a fruit of the Spirit?

representations: a fruit tree with nine fruit
a list of church activities for youth
steps: Show how a fruit looks in daily life.
Say why taking part in church matters.

board.do: Draw tongues of fire over a group of people.

board.say: What happened on the day of Pentecost?

board.do: Wait for the learner to say the Holy Spirit came.
List church activities and what each builds.

misconceptions.ask: On which day did the Spirit come on the disciples?
misconceptions.repair: Read Acts 2:1: the day of Pentecost, fifty days after Passover.

misconceptions.ask: What signs came with the Holy Spirit at Pentecost (Acts 2:2-3)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Acts 2:2-4: a sound like a violent wind, tongues like fire, speaking in other languages.

misconceptions.ask: Which is a fruit of the Spirit?
misconceptions.repair: Read Galatians 5:19-23: anger is with the works of the flesh; the fruit begins with love.

listen_for: It is not important; church is for adults
misconceptions.ask: Why is it important for a young person to take part in church activities?
misconceptions.repair: List youth activities (choir, ushering, outreach, Sunday school helping) and what each builds. Read Hebrews 10:24-25.

checks.question: On which day did the Holy Spirit come on the disciples?
Why should young people take part in church activities?
checks.answer: It builds faith, gifts and responsibility
